#find reaction level differences using gapseq files
```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)

setwd("~/Documents/Penn_State/Genomes/SynCom")

# ------------------------------
# Step 1: Read gapseq annotation files
# ------------------------------
mada85 <- read.delim("gapseq.mada85/Pathways.edited.tsv")
mada106 <- read.delim("gapseq106/Pathways106.edited.tsv")
pseudo <- read.delim("Pseudo/Andres-all-Pathways_edit.tbl")

names(mada85)[names(mada85) == "Completeness"] <- "Completeness.mada85"
names(mada85)[names(mada85) == "Name"]         <- "Name.mada85"

names(mada106)[names(mada106) == "Completeness"] <- "Completeness.mada106"
names(mada106)[names(mada106) == "Name"]         <- "Name.mada106"

names(pseudo)[names(pseudo) == "Completeness"] <- "Completeness.pseudo"
names(pseudo)[names(pseudo) == "Name"]         <- "Name.pseudo"

# ------------------------------
# Step 2: merge files
# ------------------------------

#p.comp1 <- merge(mada85, mada106, by = "ID", suffixes =c(".g1", ".g2"))
p.comp <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y, by = "ID", all = TRUE, suffixes = c("", "")),
                 list(mada85, mada106, pseudo))

# names(p.comp)[names(p.comp) == "Completeness.1"] <- "Completeness.mada85"   # Mada85
# names(p.comp)[names(p.comp) == "Completeness.y"] <- "Completeness.mada106"   # Mada106
# names(p.comp)[names(p.comp) == "Completeness"]   <- "Completeness.pseudo"
# 
# names(p.comp)[names(p.comp) == "Name.x"] <- "Name.85"
# names(p.comp)[names(p.comp) == "Name.y"] <- "Name.106"
# names(p.comp)[names(p.comp) == "Name"]   <- "Name.pseudo"

# ------------------------------
# Step 3: Subset pathways
# ------------------------------
# ------------------------------
# Unique to Mada85
# ------------------------------
unique.mada85 <- subset(
  p.comp,
  Completeness.mada85 > 0 &
    (is.na(Completeness.mada106) | Completeness.mada106 == 0) &
    (is.na(Completeness.pseudo)  | Completeness.pseudo == 0)
)

# ------------------------------
# Unique to Mada106
# ------------------------------
unique.mada106 <- subset(
  p.comp,
  Completeness.mada106 > 0 &
    (is.na(Completeness.mada85) | Completeness.mada85 == 0) &
    (is.na(Completeness.pseudo) | Completeness.pseudo == 0)
)

# ------------------------------
# Unique to Pseudo
# ------------------------------
unique.pseudo <- subset(
  p.comp,
  Completeness.pseudo > 0 &
    (is.na(Completeness.mada85)  | Completeness.mada85 == 0) &
    (is.na(Completeness.mada106) | Completeness.mada106 == 0)
)

# ------------------------------
# Shared across all three
# ------------------------------
shared.all <- subset(
  p.comp,
  Completeness.mada85 > 0 &
    Completeness.mada106 > 0 &
    Completeness.pseudo > 0
)

#venn diagram
library(VennDiagram)
library(grid)


grid.newpage()          # clears the plot device
grid.draw(venn.plot) 

# ------------------------------
# Step 1: Define sets
# ------------------------------
set85    <- p.comp$Name.mada85[p.comp$Completeness.mada85 > 0]
set106   <- p.comp$Name.mada106[p.comp$Completeness.mada106 > 0]
setPseudo<- p.comp$Name.pseudo[p.comp$Completeness.pseudo > 0]

# ------------------------------
# Step 2: Unique & overlaps
# ------------------------------
only85    <- setdiff(set85, union(set106, setPseudo))
only106   <- setdiff(set106, union(set85, setPseudo))
onlyPseudo<- setdiff(setPseudo, union(set85, set106))

overlap85_106     <- setdiff(intersect(set85, set106), setPseudo)
overlap85_Pseudo  <- setdiff(intersect(set85, setPseudo), set106)
overlap106_Pseudo <- setdiff(intersect(set106, setPseudo), set85)

allThree <- intersect(intersect(set85, set106), setPseudo)

# ------------------------------
# Step 3: Draw base 3-way Venn
# ------------------------------
venn.plot <- venn.diagram(
  x = list("Mada.85: NonInhibitory" = set85,
           "Mada.106: Inhibitory"   = set106,
           "Pseudo"                 = setPseudo),
  filename = "vennpdf.pdf",
  fill = c("skyblue", "lightgreen", "orange"),
  alpha = 0.5,
  scaled = FALSE,
  cex = 0,            # hide numbers
  cat.cex = 1.5,      # category label size
  cat.pos = c(90, 345, 263),  # all titles above
  cat.dist = c(0.21, 0.30, 0.1),
  margin = 0.1,
  height = 50,
  width = 50, 
  resolution = 300
)
#grid.newpage()
grid.draw(venn.plot)
grid.text(paste(overlap106_Pseudo, collapse="\n"), x=0.65, y=0.5, gp=gpar(cex=0.6))
grid.text(paste(only106, collapse="\n"), x=0.758, y=0.45, gp=gpar(cex=0.6))
# ------------------------------
# Step 4: Add pathway names manually
# ------------------------------
# nothing here grid.text(paste(only85, collapse="\n"), x=0.20, y=0.55, gp=gpar(cex=0.6))

library(ggplot2)
library(ggVennDiagram)

# ------------------------------
# Your sets
# ------------------------------
sets3 <- list(
  "Mada.85: NonInhibitory" = set85,
  "Mada.106: Inhibitory"   = set106,
  "Pseudo"                 = setPseudo
)

# ------------------------------
# Correctly compute text for external labels
# ------------------------------

# Unique to Mada.106 (exclude Mada.85 and Pseudo)
only106 <- setdiff(set106, union(set85, setPseudo))  

# Shared between Mada.106 and Pseudo, excluding Mada.85
overlap106_Pseudo <- setdiff(intersect(set106, setPseudo), set85)

# Create text strings with counts
text_only106 <- paste0("n=", length(only106), "\n", paste(only106, collapse="\n"))
text_overlap <- paste0("n=", length(overlap106_Pseudo), "\n", paste(overlap106_Pseudo, collapse="\n"))

# ------------------------------
# Draw Venn diagram with internal counts
# ------------------------------
p <- ggVennDiagram(sets3, label = "count") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low="white", high="skyblue") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  annotate("text", x = 0.75, y = 0.8, label = text_only106, hjust = 0, size = 3) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.6, y = -1, label = text_overlap, hjust = 0, size = 3) +
  expand_limits(x = 0.5, y = 1)

p  
# annotate("text", x = 0.75, y = 0.8, label = text_only106, hjust = 0, size = 3) +
  # # Shared 106 ∩ Pseudo (bottom-right overlap)
  # annotate("text", x = 0.6, y = -1, label = text_overlap, hjust = 0, size = 3)

# ------------------------------
# Add external text labels
# ------------------------------
p

ggsave("venn85106Pseudo.pdf", p, width = 15, dpi = 1000, limitsize = F)

# Shared genes
shared_genes <- mada85 %>%
  filter(Gene %in% mada106$Gene)

# ------------------------------
# Step 4: Optional - Combine for comparison table
# ------------------------------
comparison <- full_join(mada85 %>% select(Gene, Product, COG) %>% rename(Mada85_Product = Product, Mada85_COG = COG),
                        mada106 %>% select(Gene, Product, COG) %>% rename(Mada106_Product = Product, Mada106_COG = COG),
                        by = "Gene")

# ------------------------------
# Step 5: Save results
# ------------------------------
write_csv(mada85_unique, "mada85_unique_genes.csv")
write_csv(mada106_unique, "mada106_unique_genes.csv")
write_csv(shared_genes, "shared_genes.csv")
write_csv(comparison, "gene_comparison_table.csv")
```
